g.text: Are you a victim/witness? Report a crime

• Lead Officer — Team assignment, case closure authority
• Admin — All access + analytics + officer management
Authentication: JWT token + bcrypt password hashing

S8 — Evidence Saved + Chain of Custody Log (Filled + Success)
✅ Evidence saved successfully. Chain of custody record initiated (Collection action logged).
Description: Partial fingerprint from victim's bag strap | Collected By: Officer Ahmed | Feb 22, 2026 09:15 AM
Lifted from victim's bag at crime scene
Transferred to Forensics Lab — Dr. Shahid
✅ 4 custody actions logged. Unbroken chain maintained. Evidence court-admissible.
S9 — Add Witness + Record Statement (Default → Filled + Saved)
✅ Witness "Abdul Rauf" added successfully. Statement recorded below.
I was in my shop around 9:30 PM when I heard a woman screaming. I ran outside and saw a
man on a black motorcycle grab her bag. He was wearing a dark hoodie and jeans. The motorcycle
had a partial plate "KHI-4" something. He fled towards University Road. I called the police
immediately. The woman was in shock and crying.
✅ Witness + statement saved to Crime_Witness table
Key Witness flagged | Follow-up: Feb 25 | Investigation timeline updated
S10 — Update Investigation Status + Assign Team (Default → Filled)
✅ Officer Hassan assigned as Forensics Specialist. Investigation_Officer record created.
Identify serial offender patterns by linking crimes with same suspect or MO
Feb 22: Suspect identified from CCTV. Fingerprint collected. Witness recorded.
Related Crime #98 linked — serial pattern confirmed. Awaiting AFIS + suspect apprehension.
✅ Investigation updated — Status: Active | Notes saved | Timeline entry added | Dashboard stats refreshed
S11 — Suspect Arrested + Automatic Victim Notifications
🚨 Suspect Arrested — Imran Baloch apprehended Feb 23, 2026 at 14:30
Location: University Road checkpoint | Motorcycle seized: KHI-4521 | Evidence secured
All linked victims automatically notified when suspect arrested
Dear Sarah Khan, the primary suspect in your case has been arrested. Suspect: Imran Baloch, Feb 23, 2026. — CMAS
Subject: Arrest Update — Suspect arrested: Imran Baloch. Track updates via your CMAS portal.
✅ 2 notifications sent | Victims informed of arrest | Case portal updated for victim tracking
S12 — Case Closure: Pre-Closure Checklist + Final Outcome (CASE-2026-0015)
All items must pass before case can be closed
☑ All evidence properly documented — 3 items, complete chain of custody
☑ All suspects accounted — Primary: Arrested, Accomplice: Warrant issued
☑ All victims notified of outcome — Sarah Khan ✅, Hamza Ali ✅
☑ Witness statements complete — Abdul Rauf (Key Witness) ✅, follow-up done
☑ Investigation notes comprehensive — 12 entries documenting full process
☑ Related crimes reviewed — Crime #98 linked, serial offender confirmed
6/6 CHECKS PASSED — Case eligible for closure
Primary suspect Imran Baloch convicted. Motorcycle and stolen items recovered.
Accomplice Tariq Soomro — arrest warrant active. Related Crime #98 remains open.
All evidence chain of custody maintained. Victim satisfaction confirmed.
Status: Closed | Outcome: Solved | Duration: 22 days | Linked crimes updated | Case archived
Final victim notifications sent | Officer performance metrics updated | Analytics data generated

svg.text: S1: Officer Login (Empty) → S2: Officer Login (Filled + Authenticated) → S3: Investigations Dashboard (Default — case list, stats, filters)
S4: Case File CASE-2026-0015 (Expanded — all sections: Crimes, Victims, Team, Suspects, Evidence, Witnesses, Timeline)
S5: Add Suspect (Empty Form) → S6: Suspect Saved + Link to Crime (Crime_Suspect bridge: Role, Arrest Status, Notes)
S7: Add Evidence (Empty Form) → S8: Evidence Saved + Chain of Custody (Collected → Transfer → Analysis → Storage)
S9: Add Witness + Statement (Crime_Witness bridge: Key Witness, Statement, Follow-up) → S10: Status Update + Team Assignment + Related Crimes
S11: Suspect Arrested + Victim Notifications → S12: Case Closure (Pre-Closure Checklist + Final Outcome: Solved)
